humanSelections.direction: Internal Audit-owned immutable audit export push endpoint/queue

preliminaryFindings.finding: Canonical preimages were self-referential or incomplete
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Defined domain-separated RFC 8785 preimages, exact exclusions, array ordering, lowercase SHA-256, UTF-8 and UTC timestamp rules for all named hashes.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Signature algorithm, key and producer trust policy were incomplete
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Added four purpose-specific signer contracts and fail-closed algorithm policy, trust registry, identity mapping, validity, rotation, revocation and compromise inputs.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Verdict uniqueness and read identity were ambiguous
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Submission ID now derives from trusted producer identity plus validationRunId; unique run replay/conflict/supersession and exact-submission verdict read are explicit.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Evidence transfer allowed undefined URI references
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Replaced with allow-listed exact Azure Blob version pull, conditional metadata/hash/scan verification, assurance WORM copy, private RBAC/DNS and SSRF/version-swap negatives.
Added Internal Audit policy, benchmark/test registries, evaluator release/images, schemas, limits and approval bindings; verdict binds all.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Internal Audit-owned assurance implementation package was missing
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Phase 4 adds WP-05 with Internal Audit repository/build/sign/release/ACR/deployment/operations authority; DU-16 admits signed digests only.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Submitted artifacts and evaluator isolation were under-specified
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Defined untrusted-input handling, static default, separately authorised ephemeral least-privilege sandbox and fail-closed limits.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Analysis configuration/input canonical bindings and hostile-content policies were incomplete
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Added canonical hashes plus chunking, instruction/data separation, injection corpus/control, Search schema/alias and revocation bindings.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Vector provenance and tenant/case isolation fields were incomplete
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Added tenant/case, both manifest hashes, chunk/evidence hashes, policies, embedding/schema fields, deterministic scoped keys and server-injected filters.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Prompt-injection, cross-boundary retrieval and poisoned-index recovery tests were missing
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Added hostile tests, revocation invalidation, known-good versioned rebuild and validated atomic alias switch; tools/fallback prohibited.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Audit producer authenticity and receipt binding were incomplete
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Required producer-signed events; receipt binds verified producer/key, event/body hashes, stream position and assurance signer and limits meaning to integrity receipt.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Audit stream uniqueness and continuity conflict rules were incomplete
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Enforced unique tenant/case/sequence, strict sender order, tenant:case sessions, predecessor validation and no continuity advance for gaps/conflicts/signature/schema/poison.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Local receipt success could be fabricated
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Added final body hash, role-separated receipt trust/signature verification and exact-binding guard before VERIFIED_CONTIGUOUS.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Audit size, duplicate-window, expiry and ordering relationships were absent
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Added fail-closed parameters/assertions including TTL greater than grace plus retry/reconciliation; rollback preserves all evidence.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Phase 4 work, mappings, parameters and counts were not fully reconciled
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Phase 4 catalogue is regenerated across DUs, packages, WP-05, validation, sequence, identities, mappings, owner evidence, controls and coverage.

preliminaryFindings.finding: DAG rationale and activation sequence were incomplete
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Retained 17 DUs/46 edges after acyclic verification; DU-16 depends on DU-09 for source evidence path and exact software→infrastructure→private path→copy tests→clients sequence is defined.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Three-boundary authority flow overlay was missing
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Added editable draw.io and sanitised accessible SVG for pull/copy, verdict, governed analysis/vectorisation and audit push/receipt.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Amendment HTML did not meet required Clawpilot rendering contract
preliminaryFindings.remediation: Regenerated self-contained HTML with theme detector first, exact variables, var-only component colours, required fonts and Markdown parity.

preliminaryFindings.finding: Change control did not enumerate preliminary findings/remediation
preliminaryFindings.remediation: This evidence records all 19 findings, exact remediation, status, selections, baseline/supersession, author/revision and required formal re-review.

executionBoundary: Local authoring and validation only; no Azure login, validate, what-if, deployment or runtime test.
